transcript: The sooner you learn this, the lighter your life will feel. Most of your suffering does not come from what is happening. It comes from the resistance to what is. You fight the moment. You argue with reality. You ask, why is this happening to me? But life does not ask for agreement. It only asks to be met. When you stop trying to control the wave, the wave no longer drags you. It carries you. Peace is not found by fixing everything. It is found by releasing the need to fix. Let go a little today, not forever, just for this moment. The lighter you hold life, the lighter life holds you. If these words found you, there is deeper guidance waiting for you. Inside my ebook, The Way Back to Stillness, the link is in my profile. Move gently. You are not late.
